_about: Forecast motion settings. HubSpot definitions (pipelines, stage IDs, fields, weighting) are NOT here; they come from gtm-dashboard/config.json via scripts/build.mjs.

cutoff.late_rule_note: Decision 2026-09-25: a submission after Friday 12:00 ET counts toward the following Friday's forecast week.
cutoff.holiday_note: Decision 2026-09-25: no holiday adjustments. A missed holiday week renders as a gap.

forecast_period.end_rule: Dec 31 of the forecast_week's calendar year
forecast_period.start_rule: max(submission date ET, Jan 1 of that year)

drive.test_folder_note: Set in Phase 4 for synthetic snapshots. Never the production folder.

commit.label: Commit (Worst Case)
commit.note: Decision 2026-09-25: broadened from 99% to High Confidence. Operating definition (Notion, 2026-09-18): verbal commitment received from the customer, even with residual contract-negotiation risk.

best_case.label: Best Case
best_case.confidence: Maximum if every toss-up deal closes won

definitions.nesting_rule: Commit ⊆ Gut ⊆ Best Case, so submitted values must satisfy Commit ≤ Gut ≤ Best Case.
definitions.incremental: All values are incremental closed-won USD between submission date and forecast period end, on top of Closed Won YTD.

section1._note: Decision 2026-09-25 (Q4): headline = all open stages and close dates (ties to gtm-dashboard); sub-line = close date ≤ period end incl. past-due; Best Case warning compares to in-period.
